page.overview:
Who is Topside?

{| class="wikitable" style="border-collapse:collapse;"

!style="border:1px solid black" colspan=2|Generation 1

Topside was first available carded in the 1990 series of A Real American Hero toys. ---- Appearance: yellow hair and beard; blue short-sleeved shirt with orange life jacket ("NAVY" on chest); gray pants with yellow rope belt and black boots

Accessories: simple light gray helmet; light gray missile launcher backpack with detachable U-shaped stand; short, light gray submachine gun with long magazine and extra pole-like grip in front; two red missiles. ---- [http://www.yojoe.com/action/90/topside.shtml YoJoe.com page]/[http://www.yojoe.com/filecard/90/topside.shtml Filecard]
